tags.name: Step 1
tags.description: This endpoint prepares the upload of a file in chunks. It returns a file ID that will be used in subsequent steps to upload the file chunks and finalize the upload.

tags.name: Step 2
tags.description: This endpoint uploads a chunk of the file. You need to provide the file ID obtained from the prepare upload step and the chunk number (starting from 0). The request body should contain the binary data of the chunk being uploaded.

tags.name: Step 3
tags.description: This endpoint finalizes the upload after all chunks have been uploaded. You need to provide the file ID and details about the file, including its name, size, and the number of chunks it was split into.

post.description: Prepare the upload of a file in chunks.

file_id.description: File ID to be used in subsequent upload steps.

post.description: Upload a chunk of the file.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The file ID retrieved from the prepare upload step.

parameters.name: chunk_number
parameters.description: The number of the chunk being uploaded. The first chunk is 0.

post.description: Finalize the upload after all chunks have been uploaded.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The file ID retrieved from the prepare upload step.

fileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

chunksCount.description: Number of chunks the file was split into.
